channel.title: Checked Lab recall checks
channel.description: Items are added when a catalogue model's United States or Canada recall record changes. A new check date alone does not add an item.

item.title: Cuisinart Custom 14-Cup Food Processor DFP-14BCNY
item.description: Cuisinart Custom 14-Cup Food Processor DFP-14BCNY. A US recall matches this model. No Canadian recall found as of 2026-11-11. An official notice for a different model is linked from the recall checks page.
